svg.title: Serenity UAV Rev T+ components overview
svg.text: Rendered from the FreeCAD master assembly; port nacelle at cruise, starboard at hover.
S1223-derived; FIXED bonded 20 mm CF spar; bonded
64 mm tandem-EDF pod on a 2 x 6704ZZ trunnion
Rev T3 shingled 8-flap; servo on measured tilt;
3.0 in (76 mm) R6 legs, A1b couple, 4 conforming
Lapped clamshell doors, bell-crank latch, door
Flight Engineer PDB -> 10 AWG through the spar ->
Wi-Fi, Zigbee, mLRS (TACCO); SiK 915 MHz, 49 MHz
SOURCE: REVN_BUILD_GUIDE_24IN.md Rev T+ Configuration; authority documents listed there.
